skill.name: modern-web-guidance
skill.description: Searches and retrieves focused guidance for modern HTML, CSS, browser APIs, accessibility, performance, privacy, and frontend security.
skill.summary: Find current browser guidance and implementation patterns for frontend development.
skill.author: googlechrome

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are lexical false positives from Markdown, JavaScript syntax, keyboard events, and ordinary web terminology. Confirmed concerns include mandatory unpinned package execution, unversioned CDN code imports, one insecure HTTP script example, shared temporary cache use, and one unsafe innerHTML interpolation. Static review was capped at 400/620 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 220 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The workflow executes modern-web-guidance@latest and proposes a wildcard command allowlist.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an immutable package version and integrity value. Request approval for each exact command instead of allowing every package subcommand.

remediation.issue: Several guides import executable JavaScript from mutable CDN URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact dependency versions and self-host reviewed assets. Use integrity metadata where static script loading is necessary.

remediation.issue: A performance example loads a third-party script over plain HTTP.
remediation.suggestion: Change the example to HTTPS and explain that production pages must not load active content over HTTP.

remediation.issue: A privacy example inserts a dataset value through innerHTML.
remediation.suggestion: Validate the video identifier against a strict format and create the iframe with DOM APIs instead of interpolating markup.

remediation.issue: The npm cache example uses a predictable shared temporary path.
remediation.suggestion: Create a user-owned temporary directory with restrictive permissions and remove it after package execution.

medium_findings.title: innerHTML assignment (XSS risk)
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The example interpolates a DOM dataset value into an innerHTML string without validation. A manipulated video ID could break the attribute context and inject markup.

medium_findings.title: Temp directory access
medium_findings.description: - In sandboxed environments where `~/.npm` is read-only or restricted, set `NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/np
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guide recommends a fixed shared temporary path for executable package cache data. Pre-creation or cache reuse can create local tampering risk.

medium_findings.title: Hardcoded URL
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The example loads a script over plain HTTP. On an HTTP page it permits network modification, and on an HTTPS page browsers block it as mixed content.

content.value_statement: Frontend guidance becomes outdated as browser APIs and support levels change. This skill finds focused implementation guides with compatibility and fallback advice.
actual_capabilities: Searches a catalog of modern web guidance using action-oriented queries.
Retrieves full guides by identifier for focused implementation work.
Covers HTML, CSS, forms, JavaScript, accessibility, privacy, security, and performance.
Explains browser support and progressive enhancement requirements.
Provides framework-agnostic patterns that can be adapted to existing applications.
Highlights modern browser APIs and practical fallback strategies.
limitations: Search and retrieval require Node.js, package execution, and network access.
Some guides cover recent browser features that need feature detection or fallbacks.
Examples are framework-agnostic and require adaptation to project conventions.
The catalog does not cover backend systems, deployment pipelines, or general scripting.

use_cases.title: Implement a frontend feature
use_cases.description: Find a current browser-native pattern before building a component or interaction.

use_cases.title: Review web quality
use_cases.description: Check an existing interface for accessibility, performance, privacy, and security guidance.

use_cases.title: Plan progressive enhancement
use_cases.description: Compare browser support and select practical fallbacks for a product requirement.

prompt_templates.title: Find a relevant guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for guidance on [frontend task]. Return the best matching guide and summarize its main recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when starting a focused frontend task.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a modern pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Find guidance for [feature]. Adapt the recommended pattern to [framework] while preserving accessibility and browser support.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when implementing within an existing framework.

prompt_templates.title: Review an implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve guidance relevant to [component]. Review the current implementation and list specific changes, fallbacks, and compatibility concerns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when improving existing frontend code.

prompt_templates.title: Design a progressive strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Research guidance for [advanced browser feature]. Propose a production approach with feature detection, fallback behavior, performance checks, and security constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for advanced features with uneven browser support.

output_examples.input: Find the recommended way to build an accessible modal dialog.
output_examples.output: A focused guide selection with native dialog guidance, keyboard behavior, focus handling, dismissal rules, and fallback notes.

output_examples.input: Review image loading for the main page banner.
output_examples.output: A prioritized checklist covering loading priority, dimensions, responsive sources, decoding, and Largest Contentful Paint impact.

output_examples.input: Plan a view transition that works in older browsers.
output_examples.output: A progressive enhancement plan with support checks, a functional nonanimated path, reduced-motion handling, and test considerations.

best_practices: Search with a specific action and interface outcome.
Retrieve only the guides relevant to the current task.
Verify browser support, accessibility, and fallback behavior before finalizing code.
anti_patterns: Do not apply every related guide without checking project requirements.
Do not treat experimental browser features as universally supported.
Do not copy remote dependency examples without pinning and reviewing them.

faq.question: What topics does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers modern HTML, CSS, JavaScript, forms, accessibility, performance, privacy, security, visual design, and browser APIs.

faq.question: Does it generate complete applications?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves focused guidance that an agent applies within your existing project and requirements.

faq.question: Does it support React, Vue, or Angular?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is framework-agnostic and can be adapted to those frameworks.

faq.question: Does it include browser compatibility advice?
faq.answer: Yes. Guides identify support status and recommend fallbacks or progressive enhancement when needed.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Yes. Its documented search and retrieval workflow runs a package that requires network access.

faq.question: Can it replace project-specific testing?
faq.answer: No. Test recommendations against your supported browsers, devices, framework, accessibility requirements, and security policy.
